entities.name: Juan Belaieff
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Juan Belaieff was a Russian and Paraguayan explorer, cartographer and soldier, notable for his investigation and mapping of the Gran Chaco region and for his role as an officer in the Paraguayan army during the Chaco War.
